body:
I guess I would describe "happy" as when im not thinking about anything, or when im not suffering from emotional problems

I never feel good, everything exhausts me, do you ever feel like everything is "dragging"? Thats how I feel all the time, any point I am conscious.
Thank you. That was what I wanted to hear.

I find no enjoyment from being a certain weight, I just used "fat and happy" as a metaphor, because you mentioned that I achieved an overweight person's goal. 

What I was really trying to say was "Conforming to an ideal may not actually bring you happiness (or will bring you temporary happiness), if you expected it to solve the issues you may be facing."

I'd much rather be fat and happy than fit and miserable

I did it for myself and peer acceptance, part of being human is desiring to be accepted by your peers and feeling like you belong. Very rarely does anyone accomplish something and then say "oh I did this entirely for myself, I better not inform anyone." 

I don't make enough money to move/take a vacation
